BL-1230 — a fixture left a git repository at backlog/.git, so every git command run from the backlog directory silently resolves to an empty repo, and no hygiene check can see it
What it solves: - "[2026-08-28] specifier: confirmed no data loss at mint — `git ls-files
  backlog/` returns 4845 paths and `git status --short backlog/` is empty,
  so the parent repo's tracking is intact. Recorded because the obvious
  worry on reading this ticket is that backlog content had been swallowed,

Approval context: One thing needs sign-off: whether the check may ever remove what it finds. This ticket says no — it reports, a human removes. That is deliberately conservative, and it means a leak keeps failing the check until someone acts. The argument for letting it clean up is that the artifact is self-evidentl…
